text: XXXIV. 1. Katīhi nu kho bhante dhammehi samannāgatena bhikkhunā nissayo dātabbo ti? . . . pe . . . sāmaṇero upaṭṭhāpetabbo ti? Dasahi kho Upāli dhammehi samannāgatena bhikkhunā sāmaṇero upaṭṭhāpetabbo. Katamehi dasahi? 2. Idh'; Upāli bhikkhu sīlavā hoti . . . pe . . . samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesu. Bahussuto hoti . . . pe . . . diṭṭhiyā suppaṭividdhā. Pātimokkhaṃ kho pan'; assa vitthārena svāgataṃ hoti suvibhattaṃ suppavattaṃ suvinicchitaṃ suttaso anuvyañjanaso. Paṭibalo hoti gilānaṃ upaṭṭhātuṃ vā upaṭṭhāpetuṃ vā. Paṭibalo hoti anabhiratiṃ vūpakāsetuṃ vā vūpakāsāpetuṃ vā. Paṭibalo hoti uppannaṃ kukkuccaṃ dhammato vinodetuṃ. Paṭibalo hoti uppannaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ dhammato vivecetuṃ. Paṭibalo hoti adhisīle samādapetuṃ. Paṭibalo hoti adhicitte samādapetuṃ. Paṭibalo hoti adhipaññāya samādapetuṃ. Imehi kho Upāli dasahi dhammehi samannāgatena bhikkhunā sāmaṇero upaṭṭhāpetabbo ti.
